text:
lina: quick thought: what if we add inline role-edit for small edits (name, seat cap, brief desc) directly in the roles list instead of opening a full detail panel? saves clicks for PMs and support.

raj: love reducing mode switches. main risk is accidental edits. need explicit save and clear affordance. maybe an inline pencil icon that toggles edit mode per-role.

lina: exactly. pattern: click pencil -> row turns into fields, Save / Cancel buttons appear, Esc cancels. small changes only; heavy permission toggles still open the full accordion.

frank: perf note: inline inputs mean more interactive DOM nodes. with 5k roles we need virtualization + lazy-init editors. lazy-init when a row enters viewport or on first click.

design-copilot: mock: https://figma.redwood/inline-edit-roles shows compact and comfy densities, and the inline pencil + confirm toast. Also included disabled SSO badge variant when org-level SSO is off.

lina: accessibility: when entering inline edit, focus should move to the first input and SR should announce "Editing Role: <name>". on save, announce "Saved changes to <name>" and return focus to the pencil toggle.

tess: +1 on SR announcements. sample patterns: role="listitem" aria-label="Editor Role \u2014 12 members \u2014 can manage models" and when entering edit: aria-live="polite" text: "Editing Editor Role". ensure Save button is descriptive (not just "Save") e.g., "Save role name".

raj: SSO handling: product prohibits per-role SSO toggling. option A: hide SSO entirely from inline edit; B: show read-only badge with link to org settings; C: show disabled toggle with tooltip. which reduces confusion?

frank: prefer B. hide interactive controls we don't support. badge helps surface current org SSO state. if org SSO enabled show badge "SSO required"; if not, show nothing to avoid clutter.

lina: good call. microcopy for badge tooltip (long): "Organization SSO is enabled; all members must sign in using SSO. Manage SSO in Organization settings." short: "SSO required org-wide."

tess: keyboard nuance: inline edit fields must be reachable by Tab but pencil toggle should be reachable by Arrow keys when not editing. Also ensure that the disabled badge isn't focusable when decorative; if it has a tooltip link, make that reachable only after expanding details.

raj: error states: Saving conflict (another admin changed name) needs inline error toast anchored to the row with retry. use a subtle inline validation for invalid names (empty, duplicates).

design-copilot: added toast examples and error microcopy to mock. also provided contrast numbers for inline controls across densities.

lina: action items: design-copilot: finalize inline-edit mock + toasts + contrast numbers; frank: prototype lazy-init editors and test with our VirtualList at 10k rows; tess: draft SR announcements and focus rules; raj: confirm product on hiding SSO controls and decide badge rules. sync Monday 9:30am in design crit.

lina: thanks all :sparkles:
